text:
nina: compliance alert just flagged archive-bucket-prod: some recent objects missing CMEK metadata :exclamation:
carlos: thanks — did we get a terraform apply that could have reintroduced legacy iam bindings?
rachel: ran `terraform state list` earlier and noticed modules/archive/legacy_backup still present, but not sure who applied it
infrastructure-bot: deploy: terraform apply modules/archive/legacy_backup by ci/pipeline at 1723456000. Changes: +google_storage_bucket_iam_binding.backup_uploader -> role roles/storage.objectAdmin
nina: that aligns. CloudAudit entry for one object (redacted):
```
protoPayload.methodName: "storage.objects.insert"
resourceName: "projects/_/buckets/archive-bucket-prod/objects/db-2026-03-21.tar.gz"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "backup-uploader@prod"
protoPayload.request.cmekKey: null
```
carlos: so uploader had storage perms but no kms:Encrypt grant -> defaulted to SSE-S3. Two vectors: RBAC drift and grant TTL/rotation mismatch.
rachel: immediate steps: 1) revoke objectAdmin binding from backup-uploader, 2) run audit query to list objects missing cmek, 3) schedule re-encrypt or quarantine. I'll open a rollback PR now.
security-bot: automated reminder: create incident ticket and attach proof of object enumeration before remediation.
auditor: for compliance record please include object keys, upload timestamps, and principal email per object. We'll need that to assess scope.
nina: suggested GCP audit query to run in bigquery: `SELECT protoPayload.resourceName, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp FROM `project.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity` WHERE protoPayload.methodName = "storage.objects.insert" AND json_extract_scalar(protoPayload.request, '$.cmekKey') IS NULL AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)`
carlos: long term: add org policy to require CMEK on buckets named archive-*, add CI lint to block reapplying legacy modules, and add KMS grant expiry alerts (notify 24h before TTL).
rachel: rolling back binding now and kicking off object scan. will update once re-encrypt job is scheduled.
security-bot: please update encops runbook with ephemeral grant TTL checks and terraform module ownership mapping within 72h.
auditor: noted. Nina, file the incident and assign encops and infra.
nina: filed INC-2026-211, assigned to @rachel and @carlos. Priorities: revoke binding, rotate pipeline creds if tied to that principal, enumerate and remediate unencrypted objects, update runbook.
carlos: thanks — will follow up on CI gate PR to prevent future reintroductions.
rachel: scan found 4 objects in last 7 days without cmek. scheduling S3 Batch copy re-wrap (or GCS copy equivalent) and tagging in incident.
security-bot: reminder: include screenshots of audit query results and confirmation of re-encryption before closing incident. :white_check_mark:
